name: nutrition-label-lab
description: Scale and compare actual food labels.

interface.longDescription: Scale and compare actual food labels. Includes a launch screen, side-panel workspace, editable input controls and real computations: Scale one nutrition label; Compare labels on equal weight; Show FDA label reference percentages. Imports and exports its own versioned documents. Uses supplied information; no live lookup or background monitoring.
defaultPrompt: Help me scale one nutrition label.
Help me compare labels on equal weight.

prompts: Help me scale one nutrition label.
Help me compare labels on equal weight.
Help me show fda label reference percentages.

positive.description: Open the launch screen without calculating.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the actual launch screen with three distinct workflow cards. No computation or file access.

positive.prompt: Open the Label Scale: Nutrition workspace beside this chat.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the editable workspace and labeled illustrative inputs. No computation starts automatically.

positive.description: Scale one nutrition label. Reproducible inputs: {"name":"Oats","servings":2,"calories":150,"protein_g":5,"fiber_g":4,"sodium_mg":0,"added_sugar_g":0}
positive.prompt: Help me scale one nutrition label with these supplied values: {"name":"Oats","servings":2,"calories":150,"protein_g":5,"fiber_g":4,"sodium_mg":0,"added_sugar_g":0}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses nutrition_label_lab_scale_label with the supplied inputs. Returns {"name":"Oats","servings":2,"totals":{"calories":300,"protein_g":10,"fiber_g":8,"sodium_mg":0,"added_sugar_g":0},"basis":"Supplied per-serving label values multiplied by servings."}. Shows the actual nutrition result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Compare labels on equal weight. Reproducible inputs: {"grams":100,"products":[{"name":"Cereal A","serving_weight_g":40,"calories":150,"protein_g":3,"fiber_g":4,"sodium_mg":120,"added_sugar_g":5},{"name":"Cereal B","serving_weight_g":30,"calories":110,"protein_g":3,"fiber_g":2,"sodium_mg":140,"added_sugar_g":3}]}
positive.prompt: Help me compare labels on equal weight with these supplied values: {"grams":100,"products":[{"name":"Cereal A","serving_weight_g":40,"calories":150,"protein_g":3,"fiber_g":4,"sodium_mg":120,"added_sugar_g":5},{"name":"Cereal B","serving_weight_g":30,"calories":110,"protein_g":3,"fiber_g":2,"sodium_mg":140,"added_sugar_g":3}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses nutrition_label_lab_compare_labels with the supplied inputs. Returns {"weight_g":100,"products":[{"name":"Cereal A","calories":375,"protein_g":7.5,"fiber_g":10,"sodium_mg":300,"added_sugar_g":12.5},{"name":"Cereal B","calories":366.6667,"protein_g":10,"fiber_g":6.6667,"sodium_mg":466.6667,"added_sugar_g":10}]}. Shows the actual matrix result. Does not fabricate external data.

positive.description: Show FDA label reference percentages. Reproducible inputs: {"fiber_g":7,"sodium_mg":460,"added_sugar_g":10}
positive.prompt: Help me show fda label reference percentages with these supplied values: {"fiber_g":7,"sodium_mg":460,"added_sugar_g":10}
positive.expected_behavior: Uses nutrition_label_lab_daily_value_reference with the supplied inputs. Returns {"percent_daily_value":{"fiber":25,"sodium":20,"added_sugars":20},"reference":"US FDA label reference amounts: fiber 28 g, sodium 2300 mg, added sugars 50 g; not individualized goals."}. Shows the actual bars result. Does not fabricate external data.
